title: Surround Config
description: Configuration file for VS Code Surround extension snippets

items.description: Array of snippet groups or standalone snippets

snippetGroup.description: A group of snippets scoped to specific languages

languages.description: Language IDs this group applies to. Omit for all languages.

groupSnippet.description: A snippet within a group (inherits languages from the group)

label.description: Display name shown in the quick pick menu

description.description: Short description shown next to the label

snippet.description: VS Code snippet body. Use $TM_SELECTED_TEXT for the selected text.

disabled.description: Set to true to disable this snippet

standaloneSnippet.description: A standalone snippet with optional language filtering

label.description: Display name shown in the quick pick menu

description.description: Short description shown next to the label

snippet.description: VS Code snippet body. Use $TM_SELECTED_TEXT for the selected text.

disabled.description: Set to true to disable this snippet

languageIds.description: Language IDs this snippet applies to. Supports '*' for all and '-lang' for exclusion.
